Right triangle ABC with the right angle at C, legs BC = a and AC = b, and the dashed altitude CD to the hypotenuse, which it splits into AD = x and DB = y; right angles marked at C and D.
Trapezoid UPQT with vertical parallel sides UP = b and TQ = a and base UT split at M into UM = a and MT = b; segments PM and MQ, each labelled c, meet at a right angle at M.
